title: OSDR Multi-Crop Space Agriculture Meta-Analysis: Dashboard & ML Pipeline for space-grown lettuce and mizuna from NASA OSDR OSD-745, OSD-655 and OSD-780
description: Interactive dashboard and machine learning analysis pipeline comparing the nutritional composition and food-safety microbiology of red romaine lettuce (Lactuca sativa cv. 'Outredgeous'; OSD-745; VEG-01A, VEG-01B, VEG-03A) and mizuna mustard (Brassica rapa var. japonica; OSD-655 and OSD-780; VEG-04A, VEG-04B) grown in the Veggie plant growth hardware aboard the International Space Station. Analyzes elemental composition by ICP-OES, total phenolics, anthocyanins (lettuce only), ORAC antioxidant capacity, and aerobic and yeast/mould plate counts on mizuna leaf. Includes joint PCA, Random Forest flight-versus-ground classification with leave-one-mission-out cross-validation (accuracy at chance), Gini feature importance, and Mann-Whitney tests with FDR correction. All values are read from the NASA OSDR archive. Built with FAIR data principles and deployed as a static GitHub Pages dashboard.
